question: Which Nutrisigma supplementation level for Garole lambs is concluded to be economically most viable, and what final body condition score did that group reach?
expect: 10 g/head/day (T1); final BCS 3.20 (from 2.65) (Table 4, p4; conclusion p5)
rendered:

The final body condition score of the group supplemented with 10 g/head/day of Nutrisigma (T1) is 3.20.
